trap-thesis-restatement.notes: STRUCTURAL. Proposed: delete both sentences, or replace with the actual finding and its scope (a mixing parameter chosen at its optimum reaches sub-ppm; the antipode-symmetrised tower reduces the error by 4x). RIGOR (reported, not fixed - MAJOR, two distinct policy violations). (1) ABSOLUTE-MASS EXCISION. The whole block is about correcting THE NEUTRON MASS against THE EMPIRICAL MASS to a SUB-PPM MATCH. Per the owner ruling of 2026-08-11 the framework no longer claims an absolute nucleon mass as a prediction; m_n absolute is exactly the excised class, and the L2 dashboard lists m_n among the observables that MISS the 100x target. A sub-ppm absolute-m_n claim contradicts both. Proposed: restate as a ratio, a binding, or a splitting, or mark the block superseded. (2) ANTI-FIT / LAUNDERING. yields a sub-ppm match AT THE PRECISE OPTIMAL MIXING VALUE describes a one-parameter fit tuned to its optimum, and the next sentence reads that fit as CONFIRMING a structural role. Under the derive-then-check discipline a tuned mixing parameter is a fit and must be labelled one. (3) EVERY NUMBER IS MISSING: by a factor of four, sub-ppm, the precise optimal mixing value, significantly undershoots - no values, no witness, no q0 pin, so none of it is checkable. This is also the shape left by a de-numeralising sweep.
